digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler config schema and mapping foundation
propositions: A provider-neutral mapping_config module must parse [tool.rebar.mapping] as a reserved section routable through read_reserved_section without triggering unknown-key warnings or errors

Axis maps (status_map, type_map, link_map, priority_map, create_defaults) deep-merge per key across layers (built-in ← default ← projects.<KEY>), while vocabulary declarations (statuses, issue_types, link_types, hierarchy) replace wholesale with most-specific-wins semantics

Configuration must validate fail-closed offline: every axis-map value must exist in its declared vocabulary (or be the skip sentinel), malformed blocks must raise MappingConfigError, and absent capabilities must be rejected
A Capability dataclass must declare which axes (has_types, has_transitions, has_hierarchy, has_link_types, has_priorities) the target vocabulary supports, gating axis-specific features
The core module must remain provider-neutral, importing no adapter code and containing no Jira-specific value literals, with concrete backends injecting defaults via the vendor-adapter seam
